investor.subject: Two deals side by side
investor.preheader: What the comparison view shows that one deal can't.
investor.headline: Two deals side by side
body: One deal on its own only tells you whether it meets your targets. Two deals next to each other tell you which one to pursue.

The comparison view lines up cash flow, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, and Offer Ceiling for each deal, and flags where their assumptions differ so you are not comparing a 5% vacancy deal with an 8% one.
You can try it with your deal and the sample property. The 21-day free trial includes three complete Pro deals and one comparison. No card, and nothing renews.

agent.headline: Two listings side by side
